farmers_markets: Isom's Orchard, Athens (summer through fall, 8am to noon)

feeding_claim.verbatim: We are producing pasture raised pork, chicken, turkey, and eggs outdoors on a rotational grazing system

pickup_locations: Isom's Orchard farmers market, Athens (summer through fall)

notes: Verifier 2026-11-22 read homepage, products, about, contact and prepared meals pages. Homepage quote confirmed. Hogs are a closed herd born on the farm with free-choice feed made on the farm; broilers start as day-old chicks from a Muscle Shoals hatchery and are rotated daily on pasture; hens free range on alfalfa fields. Farm pickup Mon, Wed, Fri 4 to 5pm and Sun noon to 1pm; delivery Mon and Tue 5 to 9pm at a flat rate by zip. Retail at S&J Produce, Madison and Isom's Orchard, Athens; restaurants Farm Burger, Huntsville and Continental Bakery, Birmingham. Also sells prepared meal subscriptions using farm meat and local vegetables. No phone on the site.
